newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian private investment growth slowing - govt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian private investment growth slowing - govt.

text.p: Malaysia's total private investment is expected to grow by 9.9 percent in 1996 compared to growth of 28.9 percent in 1995, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.

In its annual Economic Report, the Finance Ministry attributed the slowdown to lower investment in the oil and gas sector and moderating investment in the services and construction sectors, including large privatised projects.
